`Run Mode` says which run the measured columns come from. `strict` is a run that passed strict control validation (`#147`). `diagnostic (N controls ignored)` means strict validation stopped the case on `N` unsupported controls in the first stage inlist that sets any, and the case was rerun with unsupported controls ignored. ## Astero Search Track Comparisons (`#430`)

MESA's `astero` search evolves one track per objective evaluation and keeps only the last one in `LOGS/history.data`, so each FlexMESA track is compared with the MESA `26.4.1` track of the same number. `prefix` marks the last track of an unfinished run, compared with the MESA track up to the same `star_age`.
